local_only_authorship: All source scripts are saved on disk; per-image wrappers and common cutover script are also embedded in the packed .blend. Local-only/no-commit instructions take precedence over the generic committed-script convention.
render_processes: One headless Blender process at a time. All render and verification commands exited normally after final successful runs.
resource_management: Used the existing shared render-blender.service cgroup after watchdog migration; no new slice or service. Verified CPUWeight=20, cpu.max=300000 100000 and taskset affinity [0,2,4] before scene work; Blender threads=3. Did not change the osu! process or its allocation.
kept_reproducibility_inputs: Immutable source/ packed baseline blends, baseline authoring helpers, official blockstate evidence, and provenance hashes are intentional reproduction inputs, not throwaway scaffolding.
validation: Both final PNGs opened visually, both packed scenes reopened and verified, 17 legacy and 22 modern packed textures compared byte-for-byte with the official jars, all no-facing station PNG crops identical to approved originals.
